normal.text: Today in #valheim, 'dottir decided to follow up on some rumors about little ones with good stuff to buy. All she found, was an arena with a bone pile . When she got home, she also found a troll 'redecorating' her cabin (and subsequently reducing her to a red smear in the process). It probably had a strong opinion on it's buddy's head that was hanging on a wall. #linuxgaming #shareyourgames
